text:
Maya (CEO): thanks everyone for joining — please drop any hiring/org questions here and we'll answer live. tagging @Priya and @Jonas to help.
Alex (Staff SWE): quick one — are we under a hiring freeze right now? i've seen conflicting notes.
Priya (Head of People): not a company-wide freeze. we did pause a small set of reqs for budget alignment in Q2, but hiring overall continues. priority hires only: infra, platform, and core product teams.
Jonas (VP Eng): to add — after the reductions last quarter (~8% overall), leadership approved a measured rebuild. planning for net ~+7% headcount for the coming FY, focused on infra & platform to hit latency/cost goals.
Alex (Staff SWE): can we get the breakdown by team? even ballpark numbers would help for planning.
Priya (Head of People): high-level targets (subject to final approval): infra +20, platform +10, product +5, sales & enterprise +8. these are hiring targets not confirmed offers.
rachelsr (Eng Manager): what's the interview timeline change? will loops be shortened?
Priya (Head of People): yes — streamlining to 4-week cycles for IC roles. new interview template and rubric are published on Confluence; i'll drop the link in this thread after the all-hands.
nate_pm (PM): any changes to leveling or comp bands we should expect?
Maya (CEO): no immediate changes to comp bands. we're clarifying role families (esp TPM/PM) so career paths are clearer, but comp philosophy remains market-competitive.
Alex (Staff SWE): if a team loses a headcount in a reorg, what's the backfill plan? are we doing redistributions or hiring back later?
Jonas (VP Eng): managers will get allocation guidance next week. expect redistribution first, then selective backfills. we'll use contractors for short-term gaps where speed matters. no blanket layoffs planned.
Priya (Head of People): also encouraging internal mobility — if you're interested in moving teams, apply via the internal careers page. we're running an internal hiring fair next month; signup opens tomorrow.
Alex (Staff SWE): will there be an updated org chart? it's hard to see ownership after the changes.
Maya (CEO): yes — we'll publish an updated org map on Confluence and pin it in #eng by Friday. leadership will host a follow-up Q&A next Tuesday at 11am PT for any deep dives.
all-hands-bot: poll added "Do you understand the headcount plan?" options: Yes / Somewhat / No
Alex (Staff SWE): thanks — appreciate the transparency and timeline. :heart:
Priya (Head of People): i'll follow up in this thread with the hiring priorities doc, interview template link, and instructions for managers on allocations. feel free to DM if you need one-on-one time.
